inputs.name: sqliteModelDefinition.table
inputs.description: Names the table placed in the generated definition. It is interpolated directly into a single-quoted string literal without escaping, so it must be suitable for that literal.

inputs.name: sqliteModelDefinition.fields
inputs.description: Provides the field entries added after the generated id field. For each entry, the implementation reads name, type and column; only type values exactly equal to json, boolean, or number are preserved, while all others become string.

outputs.name: sqliteModelDefinition
outputs.description: Returns TypeScript source for a static readonly definition with the supplied table, id, mapped fields, and createdAt and updatedAt timestamp defaults. Table and column values are interpolated into single-quoted source literals and field names into property positions without escaping.
